speaker: Dr Haresh Singaraju
text: asked the Coordinating Minister for Public Services and Minister for Defence in addition to the SAF's established internal mental health support system, whether full-time National Servicemen identified with mental health conditions associated with psychosocial stressors are systematically linked with external health and social sector partners to address underlying triggers and support their continued well-being during and after service.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Coordinating Minister for Public Services and Minister for Defence)
text: To recap, then-Senior Minister of State for Defence, Mr Heng Chee How, had provided the description of the SAF's mental health support system in his response to Parliamentary Questions from Mr Desmond Choo and Dr Wan Rizal on 7 March 2024.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Coordinating Minister for Public Services and Minister for Defence)
text: The Member can refer to that reply as background information.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Coordinating Minister for Public Services and Minister for Defence)
text: We recognise that NSFs with psychosocial needs may benefit from the larger social support system.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Coordinating Minister for Public Services and Minister for Defence)
text: The SAF collaborates with partners on additional avenues of support where appropriate.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Coordinating Minister for Public Services and Minister for Defence)
text: We encourage NSFs who require assistance to reach out to their commanders, the SAF Mental Health Office or the SAF counselling hotline.

speaker: Dr Haresh Singaraju (Nominated Member)
text: One, from the perspective of a public healthcare doctor, and another from an SAF medical officer and commander.

speaker: Dr Haresh Singaraju (Nominated Member)
text: At this juncture, many NSFs who do see us in public healthcare do raise concerns in terms of the social strains they face during these times, and we are aware of social partners that can offer such help.

speaker: Dr Haresh Singaraju (Nominated Member)
text: I wonder if we can strengthen the communication between public healthcare and that of the SAF during their NS time, such that we can inform the commanders that these are gaps that the NSFs are facing, and therefore the kind of avenues that we can refer these NSFs to.

speaker: Dr Haresh Singaraju (Nominated Member)
text: And on the other front, as an SAF medical officer and commander, I recognise that there are avenues to support these NSFs, in terms of the various social issues they present with.

speaker: Dr Haresh Singaraju (Nominated Member)
text: But is such education provided during the commander training, or even during the medical officer courses, such that once we recognise these psychosocial stressors, in terms of who we can refer to within the SAF, as well as externally?

speaker: Dr Haresh Singaraju (Nominated Member)
text: Because from my understanding currently, it is not in the curriculum.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: On the first point, certainly, we welcome that.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: On the second one, let me check on this.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: Because generally, most of our unit commanders who oversee our NSF troops, for example, are trained and they do have schemes and mechanisms to support our NSFs – whether they have financial assistance requirements or whether there are external things that they may need, like rehabilitation services and counselling or family issues.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: We understand that there are different stressors, to which the unit commanders are charged to look after.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: And they have access to such schemes too.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: However, I think one possibility is for the mental health professionals to also provide feedback to the unit.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: Let us see how we can integrate this better and see how we can work this through in a more efficient way.
